premises.text: Peer-to-peer payment apps benefit from users' idle cash balances without providing returns to users
premises.evidence_span: it's those same peer-to-peer apps that are benefiting from cash balances and earning a return, leaving nothing behind for their users

premises.text: Users want to earn and grow their wealth through simple transactions
premises.evidence_span: Millennials, Gen Z, all of us want to earn and grow our wealth, but sometimes just lack the resources, time or energy or resources to invest

premises.text: Peer-to-peer payments can be transformed into investment opportunities
premises.evidence_span: What if peer-to-peer paybacks wasn't just a way to settle tabs, but was a way to actually build generational wealth?

premises.text: Stacks allows users to send and receive stock as payment easily
premises.evidence_span: we built a fast, simple, and secure way to send stock and we're making it the new norm and bringing it mainstream

premises.text: Users can choose to accept payments in cash or stock, providing flexibility
premises.evidence_span: she can accept the stock as is, she can switch the stock to another one of her favorites, or she can accept it as cash

premises.text: Stacks promotes social engagement around investing
premises.evidence_span: we make all portfolios and trades and transactions public

premises.text: Stacks provides security for user cash balances and investments
premises.evidence_span: we cover up to $250,000 of user cash balances and $500,000 of portfolio investments

premises.text: Stacks aims to democratize investing by making it accessible to a broader audience
premises.evidence_span: we're bringing a whole new group of individuals into the market and creating new ways that they can access it

value.text: Users can grow their wealth through everyday transactions
value.evidence_span: join us as we create limitless value with every single transaction
